page0.text:
I should call Tohsaka back.
I shouldn't break any more lamps.
...Actually, I really shouldn't be talking big after breaking over forty lamps.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-01:page0:1

page1.text:
"Hey Tohsaka."
I call out to her, but there's no answer.
That's weird. Did she step out of the house?
Where else might Tohsaka go...?
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-01:page1:1

page2.text:
"There's someone in the shed."
It sounds like Tohsaka and Saber are talking inside.
"Hey, Tohsa—"
The instant I lift a hand to call out to her...
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-01:page2:1

page3.text:
A chill runs up my spine.
I think it's because I can feel Tohsaka's magical energy seeping from the shed. It pulses with enmity.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-01:page3:1

page4.text:
"What the...?"
I immediately stop calling for her.
Even from here, I can tell Tohsaka is agitated.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-01:page4:1

page5.text:
But I can hear the two of them talking.
Before I know it, I'm eavesdropping.
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-01:page5:1

page6.text:
"What's up with him!?"
Tohsaka sounds both angry and nervous.
Saber stands silently behind her.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-01:page6:1

page7.text:
"I don't believe it. Saber, did you know about this?"
"No, I did not. I am a knight, not a mage. I only felt something was amiss. I do not understand the situation as well as you, Rin."
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-01:page7:1

page8.text: "I see. Then let me tell you. He's no mage."
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-01:page8:1

page9.text:
"What do you mean by that?"
"I mean what I said.
Magecraft is ultimately equivalent exchange. No matter what kind of Mystics you're talking about, all it does is take something from somewhere else and put it to use."
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-01:page9:1

page10.text:
"But this is different. He is creating something from nothing. He's taking something that shouldn't exist and giving it shape.
This is...a concept encroaching on reality itself.
His magecraft is nothing but a degraded version of it."
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-01:page10:1

page11.text:
"..."
I have no idea what Tohsaka is saying.
But I definitely shouldn't be listening in on the two of them.
I walk away from the shed.
I'll be lying to Tohsaka, but I should go back to her room and pretend I was waiting for her to come back...
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート九日目-01:page11:1
